objective: At least 80% exact-word top1 on synthetic_memory in the unchanged 60000-word benchmark
metric: exact lowercase target word is the first prediction; no alias credit
rules: Keep all benchmark rows, candidate words, generator errors, and scoring unchanged.
Use full-vocabulary fresh writers for training; do not restrict predictions to benchmark target ranks.
No benchmark labels, writer IDs, seeds, source IDs, or target ranks enter model inputs.
Select models and ranking settings on separate development writers, not benchmark predictions.
Do not run the benchmark during training. Gate a final run on strong development results.
Report misses, regressions, and any failure to reach 80% honestly.

development.targets: uniform over all 4–12 letter words across the complete 60000-word deployment vocabulary

selection_gate: Aim for at least 83% memory development top1 before testing the final model
limits: The benchmark was evaluated in previous work; new experiments must not inspect its mistakes or tune against new benchmark runs.
